messages:
joan: hey team, just landed — a couple quick things i can't find: who do i ping for VPN access and badge setup, which channels should i keep unmuted first-week, and any bot prefs i should know about?

marta_peopleops: welcome joan!! 
- VPN/badge stuff: ping @alex_infra in #eng-infra (include laptop serial + office desk).
- we'll add you to #new-hires and pin the onboarding doc there: https://intra.redwood.com/onboarding

sam_dev: for infra access also include your GitHub handle and manager's name when you ping alex. speeds things up.

joan: perfect — thanks. quick follow: i'm getting a lot of alerts in #eng-sre, is it okay to mute that channel?

alex_infra: totally fine. recommended pattern: 
- keep your core team channels unmuted (#eng, #prod-ops)
- mute noisy broadcast/alerts channels and use thread subscriptions for follow-ups
Steps: channel -> More -> Mute channel, or click the channel name -> preferences -> mute. Ops-bot can DM you critical alerts if you want.

dev-tools-bot: tip: if you prefer digests instead of noise, run `ops:subscribe digest daily` in a DM with me and i'll send a single summary. React with :mute: on a bot message to hide similar notifications.

sam_dev: also pro tip: star your main channels, and use threads for async questions. For urgent infra stuff ping @oncall in #eng-oncall.

marta_peopleops: :thumbsup: we've pinned the quick channel map in #new-hires and the onboarding doc has a one-pager: "Which channel for what". i'll DM you a buddy intro in a few.

joan: super helpful — one last thing: where do i post lunch/coffee invites and buddy pairing asks?

marta_peopleops: lunch + socials -> #random or #lunch-plans. Buddy pairing / mentor requests -> #new-hires or DM me and i'll hook you up.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: onboarding sync tomorrow 10:00 AM — calendar invite sent to your work email.

joan: awesome, thanks everyone! :party-parrot:
